name: Distillates (petroleum), chemically neutralized middle; Gasoil - unspecified; [A complex combination of hydrocarbons produced by a treating process to remove acidic materials. It consists of hydrocarbons having carbon numbers predominantly in the range of C11 through C20 and boiling in the range of approximately 205 °C to 345 °C (401 °F to 653 °F).]
